findings: 355: The negatively orientedCRPS states independent draws and finite first moment, checks the5/7 law against point6, and explicitly refuses a one-outcome ranking. Scale is known as of origin; unresolved probability mass cannot be renormalized away.

356–357: Bank realized loss differs from allowance, and ultimate insurance reserves differ from one-year prediction. Numerical inference begins with an analytic reference and downstream cash quantities. E6 and B0–B3 separate author pilots, source selection, runtime compatibility and future independent evidence.

357–358: Joined-sector arithmetic preserves separate legal books, gross cash and adjustment origins. Correct consolidation does not validate expected loan cash, insurance risk adjustment or retrospective information. New finite methods remain additions to the originalE1–E6 targets.

358–360: Operation-level capabilities andP0–P6 dependencies preserve bank/insurance representation in early types. The manuscript explicitly treats these as a future design sequence and keeps implementation held. Replaceable tools do not replace semantic requirements. The corpus protocol begins with bounded reference-oracle and source-panel limitations.
Six rendered pages read; chapter14 continues. No further manuscript defect confirmed.
